note: The rubric *(faz-se reverência)* inside the verse: the blind reader warned it would be heard as text if read aloud. Left to the coordinator since draft 1; *(inclina-se a cabeça)* and no rubric are the options.

*e à beleza da casa cabe repartir*: *cabe* is supplied, refused by both Latinist runs. The bare dative + infinitive is unsayable; the blind reader could not follow even this. *O Rei dos exércitos* is an option (D43).

*levastes cativo o cativeiro* held against the gate and final Latinist, who say it imports Eph 4:8 and ask *tomastes o cativeiro*. The Pauline form is this verse's own tradition; the other is opaque aloud.

*Pois os que não acreditavam*: the v2 gate asked *até* out as an added 'even'; the final gate asks *E até* back. The runs contradict; the row's bare *pois* stands. *criam* was dropped, heard as *criar*.

*bendito seja Deus* held against all three Latinist runs, who ask the verbless *bendito Deus* as at 67:20. That has an article there (*Bendito o Senhor*); here it is heard as the noun phrase 'blessed God'.
